newsitem.title: UK: Norcros plans share buy back.
newsitem.headline: Norcros plans share buy back.

text.p: Printing, packaging and ceramics group Norcros Plc said on Thursday that it plans to buy back up to five percent of the company's ordinary shares as soon as circumstances permit.
Norcros said it has been exploring ways to return value to shareholders, but had ruled out a special dividend because of the unfavourable tax consequences.
The group earlier unveiled pretax profits for the year to end-March of 55.2 million stg, up from 13.7 million previously.
However, the results included exceptional gains of 45.5 million stg, which were mainly derived from the disposal of two of its businesses, P.P. Payne and Nor Systems.

"Significant progress was made this year towards achieving the three major objectives set out in the 1996 reports and accounts -- to improve profitability, to focus on a more cohesive group of businesses and to strengthen our balance sheet," the company said in a statement accompanying results.
